lessons.title: Natural Disasters, Causes, Consequences and Precautions
lessons.description: Earthquakes, tsunamis, avalanches, global warming, droughts

questions.rule:
• Disasters:
- Earthquake (Deprem): Sudden shaking of the ground caused by fault lines.
- Tsunami (Dev dalga): Huge ocean wave caused by undersea earthquakes.
- Avalanche (Çığ): A large mass of snow sliding down a mountain.
- Landslide (Heyelan): Falling of rocks and soil down a slope.
- Flood (Sel): Overflow of water submerging dry land.
- Drought (Kuraklık): Long period without rain leading to water shortage.
- Forest fire (Orman yangını): Destruction of forests by fire.
• Environmental Issues: Global warming, greenhouse effect, deforestation, pollution.
• Precautions: Plant more trees, save water and energy, prepare an emergency earthquake bag, use renewable energy.
questions.examTip: LGS reading passages often ask about 'prevention / precaution' (önlem) and 'causes' (sebepler). For drought -> save water; for landslide/erosion -> plant trees!

questions.prompt: A massive mass of snow sliding rapidly down a mountainside is called a(n) _____.
questions.explanation: Dağdan aşağı hızla kayan büyük kar kütlesine çığ (avalanche) denir.

questions.prompt: What is the best precaution to prevent soil erosion and landslides on steep slopes?
questions.explanation: Ağaçlandırma ve orman yetiştirme (planting trees) köklerin toprağı tutmasını sağlayarak erozyon ve heyelanı önler.

questions.prompt: A drought occurs when an area receives too much heavy rain for many weeks, causing rivers to overflow.
questions.explanation: False! Aşırı yağmur seli (flood) oluşturur; kuraklık (drought) ise uzun süre hiç yağmur yağmaması durumudur.

questions.prompt: Which item MUST be included in an emergency earthquake bag?
options: A flashlight, whistle, first-aid kit and bottled water
questions.explanation: Deprem çantasında el feneri (flashlight), düdük (whistle), ilk yardım kiti ve su bulunmalıdır.

questions.prompt: The increase in the Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gas emissions is called global _____.
questions.explanation: Sera gazları nedeniyle yeryüzü sıcaklığının artması küresel ısınmadır (global warming).

questions.prompt: Match the disasters with their definitions:

matchingPairs.right: Violent shaking of the earth's surface
Huge ocean waves triggered by undersea tremors
Prolonged dry weather with no rainfall
Inundation of land by an excess amount of water

questions.prompt: To save our planet and reduce global warming, what should people do?
options: Use renewable energy (solar, wind) and avoid wasting resources
questions.explanation: Yenilenebilir temiz enerji kullanmak ve kaynakları tasarruflu tüketmek gezegenimizi korur.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: Natural Forces LGS Reading & Chart Exam
lessons.description: LGS MEB environmental awareness and natural disaster reading exam

questions.prompt: "Glaciers are melting rapidly, sea levels are rising, and extreme weather events are becoming more frequent." What is the main cause of these phenomena?
questions.explanation: Buzulların erimesi ve deniz seviyesinin yükselmesi küresel ısınmanın doğrudan sonucudur.

questions.prompt: During an earthquake, what is the safest action to take indoors?
options: Drop, cover and hold on under a sturdy table, away from windows
questions.explanation: 'Çök, kapan, tutun' (Drop, cover, hold on) sağlam bir masanın yanında yapılması gereken en güvenli harekettir; asansör ve balkondan uzak durulmalıdır.

questions.prompt: A violent tropical storm with very strong rotating winds is called a _____ or hurricane.
questions.explanation: Dönen şiddetli fırtına hortum (tornado/hurricane) adını alır.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a renewable and eco-friendly energy source?
questions.explanation: Rüzgar ve güneş enerjisi temiz ve yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarıdır.

questions.prompt: Turning off the tap while brushing teeth and taking shorter showers helps to save water against drought.
questions.explanation: True! Diş fırçalarken musluğu kapatmak ve kısa duş almak su tasarrufu sağlar.

options: Cutting down or clearing large areas of trees and forests
questions.explanation: 'Deforestation' ormanların yok edilmesi ve ağaçların kesilmesi anlamına gelir.

questions.prompt: Match eco-friendly actions with their positive impacts:

matchingPairs.right: Reduces waste and saves raw materials
Decreases air pollution and carbon emissions
Saves energy and reduces fossil fuel consumption
Produces oxygen and prevents soil erosion

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarizes our responsibility towards planet Earth?
options: We must protect nature and natural resources for future generations
We can waste everything because resources are infinite
Only governments should care about nature
questions.explanation: Gelecek nesiller için doğayı ve doğal kaynakları korumak her insanın sorumluluğudur.
